presets.label: How is P&L attributed to rules?

answers.title: What is this app?
answers.body: Personal trading-decision-support system. FastAPI backend runs daily Kronos candlestick forecasts on a watchlist, emits rule-based BUY/SELL opportunities, tracks per-rule P&L from manually logged trades. This is a frozen public demo — the live system runs on the operator's laptop with bidirectional sync to a Railway replica.

answers.title: How accurate are the predictions?
answers.body: Accuracy is tracked per (horizon, target) on every prediction once actuals land. Headline metrics: 1d MAPE around 1.8%, 5d MAPE around 4.6%, 1d hit-rate around 61%. Drift detector flags pairs whose recent MAPE has degraded past threshold and posts to Telegram. See the Predictions → Accuracy tab for the full grid.

answers.title: How do opportunities get generated?
answers.body: An hourly worker runs a fixed rule set over recent predictions: trend-breakout, mean-reversion, gap-fill, momentum-thrust. Each fires only when the prediction's confidence and the rule's gating thresholds are met. Each opportunity is weighted by the rule's historical hit-rate so high-volume / low-edge rules surface lower.

answers.title: How is P&L attributed to rules?
answers.body: Manually logged trades carry an opportunity_id back to the rule that produced them. Per-rule P&L rolls up from every closed trade, so a rule with high hit-rate but low average win still ranks below a rare but high-magnitude rule. This closes the loop between forecast → signal → actual outcome.

answers.title: What model produces forecasts?
answers.body: Kronos — an open candlestick prediction model. Inference runs on the operator's laptop (GPU-eligible) and the forecasts are synced to the always-on Railway replica. The demo ships no model weights and runs no inference; the visible forecasts are frozen historical outputs.

answers.title: What data sources feed this?
answers.body: Market data from yfinance for prices and IV percentile; FRED for macro signal layer (rates, spreads, employment). TradingView webhook receiver for chart-context screenshots. A separate vault-indexer sidecar embeds an operator-curated knowledge corpus for the Research tab. None of these are called by the public demo — all data here is frozen as of the cutoff date.
